steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Rank. Each asset is placed by whether the register and the network agree.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

outcome.verdict: 2 assets do not match the register

findings.title: Found on the network but not registered
findings.fix: Register the device or remove it

findings.title: Registered but not found on the network
findings.fix: Confirm the asset is retired or find it

outcome.notChecked: Assets not discovered by the scan.

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (1 high, 1 medium, 1 low).
[high] asset-printer-2:12  Found on the network but not registered.
       Fix: Register the device or remove it.
[medium] asset-vm-204:19  Registered but not found on the network.
       Fix: Confirm the asset is retired or find it.
[low] asset-phone-88:26  Asset with no owner.
       Fix: Assign an owner.
Not checked: Assets not discovered by the scan.
pros: Flags an asset found but not registered, an asset registered but not found, and an asset with no owner.
cons: Not checked: Assets not discovered by the scan.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-techops-asset-reconcile skill on the records for this review.
